primitives.name: Static Balance Asymmetry Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Static balance:** force platform (PostureWin, 40 Hz), single-leg stance, eyes open/closed × 3 trials; parameter = mean CoP velocity (CoPVm); asymmetry via symmetry index SI (0 = perfect symmetry; positive = more oscillation on injured/non-dominant limb).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'SI': 'dimensionless symmetry index', 'CoPVm': 'cm/s mean center of pressure velocity'}
primitives.assumptions: CoPVm data is sampled at 40 Hz; single-leg stance is stable; eyes closed condition increases sensitivity to imbalance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: SI > 0.05 indicates significant asymmetry; threshold set by pre-registered cutoffs.

layer2.mapping: SI maps to GSI's injury risk classifier; GSE uses SI to update player availability states.
layer2.telemetry: Center of pressure velocity variance during unilateral stance.

primitives.name: Dynamic Balance Composite Score
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Dynamic balance:** Y-Balance Test — max reach in anterior, posteromedial, posterolateral directions, normalized to limb length; composite score; side-to-side asymmetry.
primitives.assumptions: Reach distances are normalized to limb length; three-directional reach is symmetrically assessed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Composite score < 89.6% signals high asymmetry; used as binary classifier cutoff.

layer2.mapping: YBT composite maps to GSI's injury prediction; GSE uses it to model movement instability.
layer2.telemetry: Normalized maximum reach distance across three spatial directions.

primitives.name: Subsequent Injury Risk Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Logistic regression: subsequent injury (yes/no) ~ GP group membership.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'p': 'probability of subsequent injury', 'GP': 'binary indicator (1 = groin pain)', 'SI': 'static balance asymmetry index', 'YBT_composite': 'dynamic balance composite score'}
primitives.assumptions: Logistic link function ensures bounded probability; predictors are independent and additive.
primitives.breakdown_regime: OR = 7.48 for injury risk; model discriminates between groups with high confidence.

layer2.mapping: Risk model underpins GSI's probabilistic injury forecasts; GSE applies it to simulate player degradation.
layer2.telemetry: Binary outcome of injury occurrence within 10 months.
